payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about previously reported results in the context of speculation detection using transformer-based architectures.

claims.text: Previous work on speculation detection reported results that were improved by at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution using transformer models.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa in the context of speculation detection, which contrasts with results on other benchmark datasets.
